sloka: स्व धर्मस्य च संयोगात् जितः तेन महात्मना ।स्वर्गः परिगृहीतः च प्राणान् अपरिरक्षता ॥४-२५-१०॥
transliteration: sva dharmasya ca saṁyogāt jitaḥ tena mahātmanā ।svargaḥ parigṛhītaḥ ca prāṇān aparirakṣatā ॥4-25-10॥

translations.english: 'Great Vali has earned a place in heaven by virtue of his own dharma and not caring for his own life .He has got the heavenly position he earned.
